description: Escalation Standard Operating Procedure — procedure for handling human escalations. Sourced from system_responsibility.md.

entries.title: Automatic escalation: route immediately with full context
entries.description: When an automatic escalation trigger fires, the harness must immediately route the finding to the appropriate human reviewer with full context: the original finding, all review results, the specific trigger reason, and the recommended action.
entries.action: 1. Set human_escalation.required = true. 2. Include all review results as context. 3. Specify trigger reason. 4. Assign recommended_reviewer based on trigger type. 5. In v1: synchronous notification (log + mark for review).

entries.title: Conditional escalation: evaluate threshold before routing
entries.description: Conditional escalations are evaluated after all checks complete. If the confidence score or individual factor scores fall below their thresholds, escalate. Otherwise, the review can complete autonomously.
entries.action: 1. Evaluate all conditional thresholds. 2. If any threshold breached: route to human. 3. If all thresholds met: complete review autonomously. 4. Log escalation decision for audit.

entries.title: Reviewer assignment by escalation type
entries.description: Different escalation types require different reviewer expertise. Evidence issues → technical_reviewer. Severity/CVSS issues → senior_pentester. Data protection issues → data_owner. Client-facing issues → project_manager.
entries.action: Assign recommended_reviewer based on trigger: evidence insufficient → technical_reviewer; severity-confidence mismatch → senior_pentester; data protection → data_owner; model disagreement → technical_reviewer; classification uncertain → technical_reviewer.
